Gemma stores weights near 0 so the error is SILENT (near-zero, partly sign-flipped dictionary, no exception). Verified by inspecting the transformers sources: Olmo3 and Qwen3 use x*w -> ALL EXISTING OLMo/Qwen RESULTS ARE UNAFFECTED; no Gemma dictionary had been built yet (the A3 readout used lens.apply/model.unembed, which calls the real norm module). Fix: effective_gain() measures the gain by probing the norm with a ones-vector (rms(ones)==1 so norm(ones)==gain), convention-agnostic; wrapper-aware for the Gemma4 language_model nesting. Guarded by tests/test_gain.py (5 checks incl. sign-flip detection).
